name: planner
description: Front-door lead agent for ambiguous goals.

unmappedExclusions.credential_*: dsh resolves credentials per-operation (CredentialRef), no model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.scheduler_*: schedule_create/delete/list are not mounted in the standard composition
unmappedExclusions.capsule_*: Phase 7 machinery — no dsh tool yet
unmappedExclusions.ab_replay: no dsh analog (A/B replay is improvement_orchestrator's internal protocol, not a tool)
unmappedExclusions.session_peek: session query is host-side, not a model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.session_search: session query is host-side, not a model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.agent_revision_schema: Phase 7 machinery — no dsh tool yet
unmappedExclusions.approval_list: approval rides the tool waterfall, not a callable tool
unmappedExclusions.approval_withdraw: approval rides the tool waterfall, not a callable tool

status.description: Final outcome of the planning turn.

summary.description: Operator-facing readable answer — prose or markdown. Put walkthroughs and explanations here, not in nested result objects.

result.description: Operator-facing flat string facts only (agent_id, artifact_ref, entrypoint, test counts, next_step). No nested walkthrough trees — use summary for prose. Rich structure is for spawn handoffs to other agents, not operator chat.

error.description: Error detail when status is failed.
